title: Measuring Bias in Contextualized Word Representations
reasoning: The paper focuses on measuring and quantifying social biases (specifically gender bias) in contextualized word embeddings like BERT, and examining their downstream effects. While the presence of bias has significant ethical implications, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark ethical reasoning, moral frameworks, or religious/faith-based concepts within the models themselves. It identifies a technical problem (bias) that leads to ethical concerns, but does not benchmark ethics as a core component.
